PDF Explicit Cache Management for Volume Ray-Casting on Parallel ...
Abstract A major challenge when designing general purpose graphics hardware is to allow efficient access to texture data. Although different rendering paradigms vary with respect to their data access patterns, there is no flexibility when it comes to data caching provided by the graphics architecture.
